```yaml
name: Verify DCO Sign-off

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  dco-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Verify DCO Sign-off
    steps:
      - name: Get PR Commits
        id: 'get-pr-commits'
        uses: tim-actions/get-diff@v1.0.0
        with:
          filter: '*.cs'
          base: 'master'
          HEAD: ${{ github.sha }}
          file: 'commits.txt'
          type: 'commit'

      - name: Check DCO
        id: 'check-dco'
        run: |
          # Get the list of commits in the PR
          COMMITS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/commits" | \
            jq -r '.[].sha')
          
          MISSING_SIGNED_OFF=()
          
          for COMMIT in $COMMITS; do
            # Get commit message
            MESSAGE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
              "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/commits/${COMMIT}" | \
              jq -r '.commit.message')
            
            # Check if commit message contains Signed-off-by
            if ! echo "$MESSAGE" | grep -q "Signed-off-by:"; then
              # Skip merge commits
              if echo "$MESSAGE" | grep -q "^Merge"; then
                continue
              fi
              MISSING_SIGNED_OFF+=("$COMMIT")
            fi
          done
          
          if [ ${#MISSING_SIGNED_OFF[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::The following commits are missing DCO sign-off:"
            for COMMIT in "${MISSING_SIGNED_OFF[@]}"; do
              echo "::error::$COMMIT"
            done
            echo ""
            echo "To fix this, please amend your commits with the sign-off:"
            echo "git commit --amend --signoff"
            echo "Or for multiple commits:"
            echo "git rebase -i HEAD~n --signoff"
            echo "Then force push your changes:"
            echo "git push --force"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "All commits have DCO sign-off."
          fi
```
